prototype_notice: Procedural prototype, not finished anime; abstract ridges, one silhouetted traveler, moon and sparse particles only.

scenes.motif: Abstract moonlit ridges under open darkness; one small stationary silhouetted traveler below center with sparse drifting particles as faint traces; desaturated blue-gray and charcoal with dim pearl moon, conveying tired stillness and isolation.
scenes.camera: Wide landscape with broad negative space above the traveler and moon offset from the figure; restrained slow lateral drift, traveler remains stationary and small.

scenes.motif: Same abstract ridges and stationary traveler, now suffused with faint faded amber suggesting an indistinct recollection; no literal memory imagery, dim warmth held within the blue-gray landscape.
scenes.camera: Slightly closer framing with gentle inward move; traveler stays small and grounded, moon held as stable anchor.

scenes.motif: Recollection withdraws into slate and muted indigo ridges; only a faint trace of amber remains among cooler tones, particles thinned, traveler held in spacious quiet as weariness returns.
scenes.camera: Return toward the opening spacious wide framing at the same traveler position; camera settles with minimal movement.

scenes.motif: Weaker echo of recollection: faint dusty amber returns within charcoal and blue ridges, abstract particles only, no dramatic reveal; traveler remains isolated and stationary in generous darkness.
scenes.camera: Wide landscape preserving generous negative space around the isolated traveler; restrained slow drift, no abrupt change.

scenes.motif: Warmth recedes into muted blue-gray with a residual warm tint; abstract ridges and small traveler persist quietly beneath the moon, particles visually quieter, ending in subdued visibility without resolution.
scenes.camera: Balanced wide view with small traveler beneath the moon and readable ridge contours; movement settles to near stillness.
